summary: TELA Bio filed an 8-K reporting a Limited Consent to Credit Agreement and Guaranty dated September 28, 2026 with Perceptive Credit Holdings V, LP as administrative and collateral agent and the Required Lenders under the November 13, 2025 credit agreement. The consent waives testing of the minimum Revenue covenant under Section 10.02 for fiscal quarters ending on or about September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2026. The full consent will be filed as an exhibit to the company's Form 10-Q for the September 30, 2026 quarter. CEO Heather Getz signed the filing. No securities transaction, price, stake, premium, board recommendation, or advisor was disclosed, and the waiver covers only two quarters, so covenant compliance and potential dilution or restructuring risk in later periods remain the key items to monitor.
